## Modern, lightweight theme engine for iOS 16–26
Bring icon themes to modern iOS releases.

screenshots.accessibilityText: A themed Home Screen with custom icons, widgets, live Calendar and Clock icons, and Dock icons
Themed app icons displayed in the Share Sheet, with themed Settings icons behind it

views.markdown:
- Themes app icons on the Home Screen, Dock, App Switcher, Share Sheet, Settings, and folder previews
- Preserves themed live Calendar dates and Clock faces and hands
- Uses existing WinterBoard and SnowBoard `.theme` packages with no conversion
- Includes a master switch, installed-theme picker, and quick access to the theme folder
- Available for free

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-10
- Initial release.
- Themes app icons on the Home Screen, Dock, App Switcher, Share Sheet, Settings, and folder previews.
- Preserves themed live Calendar dates and Clock faces and hands.
- Supports existing WinterBoard and SnowBoard theme layouts.
- Includes a master switch, installed-theme picker, theme-folder shortcut, and respring action.
- Supports iOS 16 through 26 on rootless and RootHide jailbreaks.
- Applies continuous-corner rounding to opaque theme artwork.
